question: 004 period differences persist at 176/182/188: are they due to observed hour/weekend/current-production composition or a single week/month/profile?
input: 004 exact-time records with fixed high/onset labels at182, source hash verified
standardization: Compare Jan-Jun and Jul-Aug only in cells with positive exposure in both periods; pooled exposure common weights. Repeat inverse-profile weighting. Current production is posthoc, not intervention.
metrics: Onset among eligible and high among all valid records; raw/overlap/standardized rates; excluded exposure/events; cell sample sizes; standardized peak quantiles
influence: Leave each calendar week, month and exact daily profile out of numerator and denominator without recomputing labels or reconnecting time gaps
bootstrap: Seed20260927, 2000 replicates; resample observed calendar-day and calendar-week blocks separately within period; report descriptive percentile bands, not certified confidence intervals
decision: If standardized difference reverses, revise crude period interpretation; if positive under all sensitivity checks, retain descriptive period difference, not a causal claim.
